cld_far.configuration.title: Distant terrain
cld_far.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Draw terrain beyond render distance (TelipailoCraft worlds only)
cld_far.configuration.step.tooltip: Step at the near edge: smaller is finer but slower. Changing it rebuilds everything
cld_far.configuration.mountains.tooltip: How many times finer the grid is in mountains (1 = same as plains)
cld_far.configuration.clearWater.tooltip: Distant water is translucent over the seabed like in game, no hard seam at the chunk edge. Off is cheaper
cld_far.configuration.detail.tooltip: Higher keeps the fine grid further from the player (more tiles)
cld_far.configuration.fog.tooltip: Fraction of the distance where terrain starts fading into fog
cld_far.configuration.spyglass.tooltip: In the spyglass the whole visible terrain becomes blocky; each ready piece replaces the coarse one
cld_far.configuration.spyglassRange.tool: How far the spyglass shows blocky terrain
cld_far.configuration.smooth.tooltip: How soft distant terrain looks. 0: raw, sharp peaks, 1: soft
cld_far.configuration.pixel.tooltip: 0: smooth slopes, 1: flat facets, 2: blocky steps like the game
cld_far.configuration.quality.tooltip: Grid detail near the player, in mountains and far away
cld_far.configuration.look.tooltip: Slopes, stone pillars, peaks and water
cld_far.configuration.blocks.tooltip: Seam with chunks, tall cliffs nearby and blocky terrain in the spyglass
cld_far.configuration.pillars.tooltip: Karst towers and dolomite spires are drawn round and exactly in place, using the generator formula
cld_far.configuration.peaks.tooltip: With pixelation 2 a lone summit narrows in steps instead of being a wide grey box
cld_far.configuration.nearBlocks.tooltip: With Sodium the game skips blocks above and below the render distance; those parts of nearby cliffs are filled with real blocks
cld_far.configuration.blockSize.tooltip: Blocky terrain size: 1 like the game, 2 twice larger and four times cheaper
cld_far.configuration.uploadsPerFrame.to: How many finished tiles to upload to the GPU per frame
cld_far.configuration.light.tooltip: Sun, shading, haze, sunset and weather
cld_far.configuration.water.tooltip: Clarity, waves, glints, reflections, ice, shores, rivers
cld_far.configuration.atmosphere.tooltip: Cloud shadows, valley mist, earth curvature
cld_far.configuration.pauseInMenu.toolti: Wait while the game is paused
cld_far.configuration.lookAhead.tooltip: Compute what is in front first
cld_far.configuration.adaptiveUploads.to: One tile per frame when frames drop
cld_far.configuration.preset.tooltip: Sets the main options at once; Custom keeps yours
cld_far.hint.noseed: Distant terrain: no data from the server. It works only in TelipailoCraft worlds and needs cld_far on the server too.
cld_far.cmd.cache: Distant terrain cache for this world deleted
cld_far.configuration.extras.tooltip: Caves, hints, pause menu button, debug
cld_far.configuration.hideUnderground.to: Do not draw in caves without sky
cld_far.configuration.hints.tooltip: Chat hint when the server sent no data
cld_far.configuration.pauseButton.toolti: Settings button in the pause menu
